html: † אַפְּתֹם or אַפְּתוֹם (so edd.: > Gi Baer [v. p. 102 f.] from MSS, אַפְּתֹס) Ezr 4:13 וְא׳ מַלְכִים תְּהַנְזִק; of uncertain meaning: Thes Haug JBW 1853, 156 in the end (from Pehlevi afdom, Pers. فدام end); Scheft 79 treasuries (from Zend pathmā, pl. of pathma, treasury, √ path, to fill up), will endamage the treasuries of kings.
